QuestInfo.name: Enhancing the Core
QuestInfo.0: Kyrin introduced you to a talented, but arrogant, blacksmith. If he really can fix anything, maybe he can fix the core. He says he only needs Blue Ore to enhance the core.
QuestInfo.1: Can the blacksmith really power up the core using only Blue Ore? The core is supposed to be the pinnacle of technology... Might as well try, since Kyrin vouched for him. \r\n#rTip: If you wish to go back to the Blue Ore Cave during the quest, you must forfeit the quest and start again.
QuestInfo.2: Well, that wasn't easy, but enhancing the core should be worth it! Assuming the blacksmith can live up to his claims... Bring him the Blue Ore and see what happens.

1.0: You have returned with the Blue Ore and more than a few stab wounds. Well done.

yes.0: Give me the core and I will apply this experimental barrier. If I explode during the application, please tell the world how skilled I was.

npc.0: No Blue Ore? Come now! Where's your sense of scientific adventure? The future of discovery lies before us!
